abstract_pdf_comparison.normalization: NFKC expands ligatures; line-wrap hyphens are removed; whitespace is collapsed. Complete PDF abstract then equals the unchanged complete HTML body, including terminal period.
abstract_pdf_comparison.comparison_note: The already licensed original abstract is preserved byte-for-byte and exactly equals the complete official HTML abstract. The final PDF has the same wording and terminal period after disclosed line-wrap/ligature normalization, with no substantive variant or abstract footnote. Typographic normalization is used only for comparison, never to rewrite the stored original.
disclosed_variants: PDF line wrapping and typographic ligatures differ from HTML; no substantive abstract wording or punctuation difference is established.

visible_introduction: NeuJoRN 把疾病实体识别与标准化统一为动作序列预测：通过栈、缓冲区和动作历史，在同一搜索空间中决定实体边界并链接疾病概念。完整图 1 展示识别状态与标准化状态，后者结合候选概念引导的上下文注意力及提及—概念共注意力。模型使用 CNN、GloVe、ELMo 与循环网络，并从 MEDIC 中检索前 10 个候选概念。束宽为 4 时，在 NCBI 与 BC5CDR 上的识别 F1 为 88.57/88.19，标准化 F1 为 88.82/89.86；前者按提及、后者按摘要评测，不能混作逐提及链接准确率。证据限于 PubMed 文献基准，不代表临床诊断、患者结局或临床笔记上的有效性。
